clips.title: The story
paras: In Ordil'Aran, the Glowing Soul Gem serves the Cult of the Dark Strand's work in northern Ashenvale. Shadow sorcery fills the stone, which holds the spirit of an unwitting victim.

Northeast of Maestra's Post, the ruins of Ordil'Aran shelter members of the Cult of the Dark Strand and their shadowy masters. The cult's operatives carry Glowing Soul Gems, enchanted vessels that trap and torment the souls of the dead. These stones channel magical energy and bind spirits to the cult's ends.
